description: Look up targeting catalogs. kind=languages, topics or countries takes no extra arguments. kind=locations searches by country_code and/or query, or resolves location_ids. kind=channel resolves a channel by @username or numeric ID; kind=bot does the same for bots. Prefer @username for channels and bots: numeric IDs only work after this account has resolved them.
name: tg_list_targeting
title: List targeting options
